UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Represents a user profile within the Zenith Trainer application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the user profile.

WorkoutPlan.title: WorkoutPlan
WorkoutPlan.description: Represents a workout plan, containing a set of scheduled workouts.

id.description: Unique identifier for the workout plan.

ScheduledWorkout.title: ScheduledWorkout
ScheduledWorkout.description: Represents a specific workout scheduled for a particular day and time.

id.description: Unique identifier for the scheduled workout.

exerciseIds.description: References to Exercise. (Relationship: ScheduledWorkout N:N Exercise)

dayOfWeek.description: Day of the week for the scheduled workout (e.g., Monday, Tuesday).

timeOfDay.description: Time of day for the scheduled workout (e.g., Morning, Afternoon, Evening).

durationMinutes.description: Duration of the workout in minutes.

Exercise.title: Exercise
Exercise.description: Represents a specific exercise with details such as name, description, and instructions.

instructions.description: Instructions on how to perform the exercise.

exerciseType.description: The type of exercise, e.g., strength training, bio-dynamics, TRX, static.

equipment.description: Equipment required for the exercise (e.g., dumbbells, resistance bands, TRX).

videoUrl.description: URL of a video demonstrating the exercise.

HabitTracker.title: HabitTracker
HabitTracker.description: Represents a habit tracker for tracking mindfulness, study lessons, and other activities.

id.description: Unique identifier for the habit tracker.

HabitItem.title: HabitItem
HabitItem.description: Represents a single item in the habit tracker, such as mindfulness or study lesson.

id.description: Unique identifier for the habit item.

name.description: Name of the habit item (e.g., Mindfulness, Study Lesson).

program.description: Name of the program (e.g., Mathematics, Language).

lessons.description: Number of lessons for the program.

completed.description: Indicates whether the habit item is completed for the day.

firestore.reasoning:
The Firestore structure is designed to support the Zenith Trainer application's core features, focusing on user-specific data and collaborative elements. The structure prioritizes Authorization Independence by denormalizing user ownership.  It leverages path-based ownership for WorkoutPlans, ScheduledWorkouts, HabitTrackers and HabitItems.  This approach simplifies security rules and ensures atomic operations.

User profiles are stored under `/users/{userId}` which ensures clear ownership. Workout plans, scheduled workouts, habit trackers, and habit items are structured as subcollections of the user's document, enabling easy retrieval and management of user-specific data. This also supports the QAPs by allowing secure `list` operations within a user's own data.

This design eliminates the need for complex `get()` calls in security rules, enhancing security and performance. It provides a scalable and maintainable structure for the application's data.
